name: branding-3d-gift-box-opening-inside-phone-screen-with-confetti
title: A glossy 3D gift box bursting open inside a phone screen outline, with confetti and scattered shapes
whatItIs: A blue-background 3D render of an orange gift box with a blue ribbon bow opening inside the silhouette of a phone, red and blue ribbon curls, confetti dots and small floating geometric shapes (stars, triangles, squares) around it.
whatItMeans: Celebratory and app-native; nesting the gift inside a phone shape ties a reward directly to a mobile experience.
techniques: Nest a 3D object inside a device silhouette.
Scatter confetti and simple shapes for celebratory energy.
Use a bold two-tone gift box against a flat colour backdrop.

vocabulary.definition: An outline shape suggesting a phone or screen.
